categories.main_business_segments: China National Building Material Company Limited operates primarily in three major segments: Basic Building Materials (including cement, commercial concrete, and aggregate), New Materials (including fiberglass, gypsum board, wind power blades, lithium battery separators, carbon fiber, waterproofing membranes, and coatings), and Engineering Technology Services (providing engineering technology services and equipment procurement for glass and cement manufacturers). The company also engages in logistics, trading, and other related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with core technologies such as oxy-fuel coupled carbon capture in cement production, zero-carbon fiberglass manufacturing, advanced wind power blade design and production, lithium battery separator technology including aramid coating, and carbon fiber production for various applications. It integrates intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and green low-carbon technologies across its production lines, including intelligent factories and digital mines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNBM serves customers in the construction and infrastructure sectors, new energy industries (wind power, lithium batteries, hydrogen energy), automotive (new energy vehicles), electronics, and industrial manufacturing. Its products cater to domestic and international markets, including infrastructure projects, real estate, energy storage, and emerging technology sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic operations and a growing international presence. It has overseas production bases and projects in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, including Tunisia, Brazil, Tanzania, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Europe. The company is expanding its internationalization strategy with overseas mergers and acquisitions and localized operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: CNBM operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the building materials and new materials supply chains, producing raw and processed materials such as cement, fiberglass, and carbon fiber, and providing engineering services. It also engages in upstream activities like mining technical equipment manufacturing and downstream activities including logistics, trading, and technical services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development through technological innovation, digital transformation, and green low-carbon initiatives. It focuses on original technology development, integration of innovation and industrial chains, and expansion of new materials and energy sectors. R&D efforts target carbon reduction technologies, intelligent manufacturing, specialty fibers, and advanced materials for new energy applications, supported by medium and long-term incentives for talent and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: CNBM generates revenue primarily through product sales of building materials and new materials, engineering technology service fees, and trading activities. It also earns income from government grants, asset disposals, and financial asset fair value gains. The company’s revenue streams include domestic and international sales, with increasing contributions from innovative and green technology products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CNBM is a leading state-owned enterprise in the building materials sector in China and holds a strong market position domestically and internationally. It competes with other large cement and materials producers, fiberglass manufacturers, and engineering service providers. The company emphasizes its leadership in ESG practices, technological innovation, and international expansion to differentiate itself from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CNBM reported revenue of RMB 181.3 billion, a 13.8% decrease from 2023, with profit attributable to equity holders of RMB 2.39 billion, down 38.2%. The company has total assets of approximately RMB 494 billion and a net debt ratio of 86.6%. Despite short-term declines due to market challenges, CNBM maintains a large scale with steady cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capital expenditures, particularly in new materials and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNBM emphasizes its commitment to high-quality, sustainable development with a focus on green and low-carbon technologies, digital transformation, and innovation-driven growth. Its value proposition includes advanced technological capabilities, a broad product portfolio spanning basic and innovative materials, strong ESG governance, and a strategic international presence. The company differentiates itself through integrated solutions, original technology development, and leadership in environmental sustainability.
